content.text: So that was his profession, basically, to be a gladiator.
content.trans: 所以，这就是他的职业了，基本上，他是一名斗士。

content.text: So now as you are a boxer back then, you are a gladiator.
content.trans: 所以现在，你就像一个打手一样，像一个斗士。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: And there are actually some very famous movies about gladiators, like the movie gladiator
content.trans: 英语：而且实际上有一些非常著名的电影关于斗士，比如《斗士》。

content.text: with Russell Crowe.
content.trans: 用罗伯特·德尼罗。

content.text: Right.

content.text: So it's a pretty common word these days.
content.trans: 英语：所以它今天很常见。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 对的。

content.text: Okay, so let's take a break.
content.trans: 好的，那么现在我们来翻译一下这个句子：

content.text: Let's listen to our dialogue again.
content.trans: 让我们再次聆听我们的对话。

content.text: And we'll be back in a bit.
content.trans: 我们很快就会回来。

content.text: Have you seen this news article?
content.trans: 英语：你看过这则新闻了吗？

content.text: Apparently an organization has made a list to name the new Seven Wonders of the World,
content.trans: 据我所知，一个组织已经制作了一个名单来命名新七大奇迹。

content.text: and people could vote for them online.
content.trans: 和人们可以通过在线投票选择他们。

content.text: Wow, that's really interesting.
content.trans: 哇，那真是太有趣了。

content.text: So who would?
content.trans: 所以谁？

content.text: Well the Great Wall of China, the Taj Mahal in India.
content.trans: 好的，以下是将英文翻译成中文的句子：

content.text: I've been there.
content.trans: 我在这里。

content.text: It really is an amazing work of architecture and art.
content.trans: 它真的是一幅令人惊叹的建筑和艺术作品。

content.text: The entire complex is made of white marble and an interior of the tomb the walls are
content.trans: 整个复杂的主体由白色大理石和墓室的内部构成。

content.text: covered with gems and emeralds.
content.trans: 英文：覆盖着宝石和红宝石。

content.text: Cool.
content.trans: 凉爽。

content.text: Also amongst the winners is Petra in Jordan, Machu Picchu in Peru and the Pyramid in Chichen
content.trans: 另外，吉尔吉斯斯坦的帕拉图奇（Peru）和阿格里科金字塔（Chichen Itza）都是获胜者。

content.text: Itza in Mexico.
content.trans: 在墨西哥的印第安人之一。

content.text: Wait a minute.
content.trans: 英语：等待一下。

content.text: It also says that the Christ Redeemer statue in Brazil and the Colosseum in Rome are wonders.
content.trans: 英语：它还说巴西的基督像和罗马竞技场是奇迹。

content.text: I would love to go to Italy and see the Colosseum stay in the middle like a gladiator.
content.trans: 我非常想去意大利参观罗马斗兽场，让它像一个 Gladiator 一样居中。

content.text: Well, let's see if we can find some Cheeberre fair and we can go towards the end of the year.
content.trans: 嗯，我们看看能不能找到一些Cheerleader公平，并且可以接近年底。

content.text: Good idea.
content.trans: 好的主意。

content.text: All right, so this list that we gave you are actually the new Seven Wonders of the World.
content.trans: 好的，所以这个列表我们给你的是实际上就是七大奇迹的世界。

content.text: It was voted online, people all over the world out of different candidates or different
content.trans: 它在网上投票，全世界的人们都在不同的候选人或不同选项中选。

content.text: places that were considered to be the new Seven Wonders of the World.
content.trans: 这些被认为是世界七大奇迹的地方。

content.text: Among those, like some of them that didn't win for example was Anchor Wat in Cambodia.
content.trans: 在那些，比如一些没有获奖的，是安德烈·瓦特在柬埔寨。

content.text: Yeah, I never understood that.
content.trans: 是的，我从不理解这一点。

content.text: You know, I think Engor Wat is such an amazing place and so big and it was the heart of
content.trans: 英语：你知道，我认为埃格罗·瓦特是如此的惊人之地和如此之大，它确实是这个城市的心脏。

content.text: this old civilization.

content.text: And instead we have other things like a statue.
content.trans: 而且我们还有其他东西，比如雕像。

content.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
content.trans: 嗯，嗯，嗯。

content.text: I don't agree with it as well.
content.trans: 我不同意这一点。

content.text: But actually the statue of Liberty of the United States was also considered as a candidate
content.trans: 但是实际上，美国的自由女神像也被列为候选。

content.text: for over a wonder of the world.
content.trans: 英语：对于整个世界的奇迹。

content.text: Well, that's right.
content.trans: 正确，这是正确的。

content.text: America doesn't have any wonders.
content.trans: 美国没有任何奇迹。

content.text: You have natural wonders, I think.
content.trans: 你有自然的奇迹，我想。

content.text: The Grand Canyon is considered.
content.trans: “大峡谷被人们认为。”

content.text: I think one of the natural wonders.
content.trans: 我感觉其中一个自然奇观。

content.text: Yes, I think Niagara Falls also.
content.trans: 是的，我认为尼亚加拉瀑布也。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: But that's an interesting point though, Marko.
content.trans: 但是这确实是个有趣的观点，马克。

content.text: We've got the great wonders of the world and we've got the natural wonders.
content.trans: 我们有世界上的伟大奇迹，也有自然界的壮丽景色。

content.text: What's the difference?
content.trans: 什么是区别？

content.text: Well, natural, a natural wonder of the world means that it's there naturally.
content.trans: 英语：自然，一个自然的奇迹存在于这个世界上。

content.text: It's not man-made.
content.trans: 它不是人造的。

content.text: All of these things that we see here,
content.trans: 这些是我们看到的这一切。

content.text: that somebody had to make them.
content.trans: 这个有人要让他们做。

content.text: Whereas for example, the Grand Canyon or Niagara Falls, they are there naturally.
content.trans: 根据提供的标准，以下是正确的翻译：

content.text: It's by nature.
content.trans: 英语：它天生是傻瓜相机。

content.text: All right, so man-made versus natural or made by nature.
content.trans: 英语：一切好，所以人造的、自然的还是由大自然造出来的？

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: So it's very interesting because you have, like we said, natural seven wonders of the world.
content.trans: 所以，它真的很有趣，因为您就像我们说的那样拥有自然七奇迹。

content.text: You have these, the new ones.
content.trans: 你有这些，新的一代。

content.trans: 没错。

content.text: I think all the panels.

content.text: The gardens of Babylon and the colossus at Rhodes.
content.trans: 英文：巴比伦的花园和罗马的巨像。

content.text: Oh, yeah.

content.text: Yeah, those ones are very cool, but not like you said.

content.text: You can't see them around anymore.

content.text: So, but maybe some of you actually, maybe your countries were considered to host one of
content.trans: 英语：所以，但也许有些你实际上，或许你的国家被列为之一了。

content.text: these wonders or maybe you voted for some of them.

content.text: That is a wonder where you come from.

content.trans: 英语：它不需要在这个列表里。

content.text: It can be something you think is wonderful.
content.trans: 英语：它可以被你认为是美妙的。

content.text: Let us know our website is englishpod.com.
content.trans: 让我们告知我们的网站是英语pod.com。
